name: Text 9
text: Remote signing is already legal and permanent in Québec — but under art. 46 it is exceptional: the request must come from a party, and the justifying circumstance must be specific to that party. Convenience does not qualify. The barrier is not the law's silence; it is that the justification burden and the disciplinary exposure sit entirely on the individual notary, who therefore defaults to "come in person".
